# YourPods

> YourPods is a gPodder-compatible, privacy-first, self-hosted podcast player for iOS, macOS, watchOS, and Apple Watch — built natively in Swift and SwiftUI. Sync your subscriptions and listening progress across all your devices using your own Nextcloud server. Version 2.0.

## Project Info

- [README](README.md): Main documentation and feature overview
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer guide and contribution rules
- [License](LICENSE): GNU General Public License v3.0

## Core Features

- **Native Apple App**: Built in Swift 5.9 and SwiftUI, targeting iOS 17+, macOS 14+, watchOS 10+, and with native CarPlay integrations.
- **Privacy**: No tracking, analytics, or ads. Fully self-hosted sync via Nextcloud/gPodder.
- **Multi-Profile**: Switch between different servers or user accounts instantly. Local-only accounts supported.
- **Sync Conflict Management**: Smart conflict resolution with options to keep local state or overwrite from server.
- **Last Synced Timestamp**: Displays the last sync time in settings for transparency.
- **Cross-Device Queue Sync**: Queue syncs across devices via your gPodder server automatically.
- **OPML Import & Export**: Migrate subscriptions to or from other apps, or back up your library.
- **Password-Protected Feeds**: Subscribe to private RSS feeds (Patreon, premium podcasts). Credentials stored securely on-device.
- **Local Accounts**: Use YourPods without a sync server for fully offline, on-device podcast management.
- **Flutter Migration**: Automatic one-shot migration of subscriptions, queue, profiles, settings, and playback positions from the Flutter-based v1.x.

## Player & Audio

- **Native AVFoundation Audio Engine**: Built on AVAudioEngine for low-latency, reliable playback with Bluetooth, CarPlay, and Siri interruption recovery.
- **Live Transcripts**: Interactive, searchable transcripts with auto-scroll.
- **Smart Chapters**: Embedded chapter support (RSS Podcasting 2.0 and description-parsed) for easy navigation.
- **Smart Queue**: Drag-and-drop reordering with "Now Playing" and "Up Next" sections, visible episode lengths.
- **Precision Control**: Granular playback speed (0.5×–3×) and custom sleep timers.
- **Skip Intro/Outro**: Configurable per-second precision (0–120s).
- **Mini Player**: Persistent playback controls across the app (NowPlayingBar).
- **Listening Stats**: Local listening history tracking.
- **Trim Silence**: Skip silent passages during playback.

## Discovery

- **Unified Search**: Defaults to Apple Podcasts (iTunes) for extensive coverage, with optional PodcastIndex support (requires personal API key).
- **Add to Server**: Discover new podcasts in-app and instantly sync subscriptions to your self-hosted server.
- **Feed Cache**: Configurable cache duration (1–48 hours) for faster load times; pull-to-refresh bypasses cache.
- **Background Refresh**: Automatic episode fetching in the background with configurable intervals (15 min – 4 hours).

## Platform Integrations

- **CarPlay**: Full queue management, Recently Updated episodes tab, Now Playing with chapter navigation, playback speed and trim-silence controls. Artwork with placeholder loading.
- **Apple Watch**: Standalone playback, offline episode transfer, configurable podcast sync limit, and complications showing playback status.
- **Dynamic Island**: Real-time playback status via Live Activities on supported iPhones.
- **Siri & App Intents**: 10 native voice commands — play, pause, stop, resume, skip forward/backward, next episode, play latest, play specific podcast, set playback speed. All available as Shortcuts.
- **Widgets & Complications**: Lock screen and watch face widgets showing current playback.

## Technical

- **Language**: Swift 5.9
- **UI Framework**: SwiftUI
- **Storage**: SwiftData (iOS 17+)
- **Audio**: AVFoundation / AVAudioEngine
- **Sync**: gPodder-compatible (Nextcloud gpodder-sync). Implements Open Podcast Sync protocol for subscriptions (SubscriptionDelta) and actions (EpisodeAction).
- **Build System**: XcodeGen (`project.yml`) + Swift Package Manager (`Package.swift`)
- **Minimum Targets**: iOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0
- **Targets**: YourPods (iOS app), YourPodsWatch (watchOS app), YourPodsWidgets (Live Activities), YourPodsComplication (watch complications), YourPodsTests (unit tests)

## Architecture

- `YourPods/YourPods/Audio/` — Audio playback engine (AudioManager: AVAudioEngine-based)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Models/` — SwiftData models (Podcast, Episode, ServerProfile, Chapter, EpisodeAction, PodcastSettings)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Networking/` — gPodder API client (GPodderClient), RSS feed parser (RSSService), URL resolver
- `YourPods/YourPods/Services/` — CarPlay, Siri (AppIntents), Live Activities, Chapters, Transcripts, Watch connectivity, Downloads, Background Refresh, Listening Stats, OPML import/export, Flutter data migration
- `YourPods/YourPods/State/` — Observable state managers: PlayerManager, PodcastManager, SettingsManager, NavigationState, SleepTimerManager
- `YourPods/YourPods/Views/` — SwiftUI views: Home, Library, Player, Queue, Settings, Search, History, Profile Selection, Downloads, Import, Episode Detail, Podcast Detail, and reusable Components (NowPlayingBar, ChapterListSheet, TranscriptListSheet, SleepTimerSheet, PodcastSettingsSheet)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Utils/` — Utility extensions (String+HTML)
- `YourPodsWatch/` — watchOS app (standalone playback, library sync, remote player, episode browsing)
- `YourPodsWidgets/` — Live Activities and widget extension
- `YourPodsComplication/` — watchOS complication widget

## Per-Podcast Settings

Each podcast can have individual settings (auto-queue mode, auto-download, remove after play, archive on complete) that override the global defaults.
